channel.title: craftzman — Blog
channel.description: Notes by Rostislav Egorov (craftzman): architecture, Rust and Go, industrial telemetry, AI agents, indie products.

item.title: What Drafta looks like: themes, typography, export
item.description: Eleven built-in Drafta themes and custom themes in JSON, four typography presets, and export to PDF, DOCX, HTML, and Markdown via styling profiles.

item.title: MCP server Drafta: agents read and write notes
item.description: Drafta's built-in MCP server gives Claude and other clients 12 tools for the entire library. How to connect it, what it can do, and how to restrict it to read-only.

item.title: AI assistant in Drafta: ⌘J and your key
item.description: How the Drafta AI assistant works: a popover via ⌘J, seven ready-made commands, editing a selection and inserting at the cursor, Anthropic, OpenAI, or DeepSeek keys.

item.title: Synchronization and encryption in Drafta
item.description: How Drafta syncs notes via the cloud or its own CouchDB, encrypts them with AES-256-GCM on your Mac, and why the account has two passwords.

item.title: Revision history and backups
item.description: How Drafta stores up to 30 revisions of each note with diff and one-click rollback and how it backs up the entire library to ZIP.

item.title: Typing from the keyboard: shortcuts, snippets, autocorrect
item.description: Drafta hotkeys, quick navigation with ⌘P, slash snippets, and type-time autocorrects — everything that keeps you from reaching for the mouse.

item.title: Drafta 1.0 has been released
item.description: Drafta 1.0 — a native Markdown editor for programmers on macOS. What's in the release, who it's for, how much it costs, and what's next.

item.title: Drafta Editor: Markdown, preview, and split
item.description: How the Drafta editor works: CodeMirror 6, three view modes, live Mermaid and KaTeX preview, callouts, table of contents, and note statistics.

item.title: Notes are files: notebooks, tags, statuses, and links
item.description: How Drafta stores and organizes notes: Markdown files with YAML front-matter, nested notebooks, tags, four statuses, bookmarks, and a link graph.
